system_overview: A formal proof module containing TLAPS-checked proofs of fundamental lemmas about graph reachability. These lemmas establish mathematical properties of the reachable-from operator defined in the graph reachability definitions module. The results are used as building blocks in the correctness proofs of both the sequential and parallel reachability algorithms.
actors_and_components: No actors. This is a purely mathematical module proving properties of directed graphs using the TLAPS proof system and natural number induction.
state_variables: No state variables. All results concern constant-level operators over graph structures.
additional_assumptions: Four lemmas are proved. Lemma 0: every node in a set is reachable from that set (trivial base case). Lemma 1 (key result): if every node in set S has all its successors in the union of S and T, then the union of S and the nodes reachable from T equals the nodes reachable from the union of S and T. The proof proceeds by induction on path length. Lemma 2: for any node in a set S, the reachable-from set is unchanged by adding that node's successors to S, and the node itself is reachable from S. Lemma 3: the set of nodes reachable from the empty set is empty.
